cover_letter:
Dear Dignify team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Automation Consultant position at your Genk hub. Marketing automation sits exactly where my work already lives: between marketing and code.

For the past two years I've worked as a freelance SEO and web specialist and as a junior digital marketer at Episto, building and optimizing websites for clients in consultancy, e-commerce and non-profit. That means writing HTML, CSS and JavaScript by hand, managing content in WordPress and Shopify, and using Python and LLM-based tooling to automate the repetitive parts. I've implemented JSON-LD structured data, knowledge-graph markup and llms.txt files, and wired up MCP integrations between WordPress, SEO tools and AI models — practical experience with the APIs and data flows that keep systems talking to each other.

Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I helped build SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (an application gallery for 12,000 staff). Enterprise scale, multiple systems, real integration constraints — and clients who needed the technical story translated into plain language. Before that, I worked as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor on a healthcare web application, so your healthcare clients aren't unfamiliar territory.

I'll be straightforward about the gap: I haven't yet worked hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Bloomreach, Selligent or Braze. My front-end, scripting and data skills transfer, and I pick up platforms quickly, which is why the training and certification path you describe is a big part of the appeal. I also bring segmentation and personalization thinking from analytics work with GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht and happy to be at the Genk hub. I'd enjoy talking about how I can contribute to your clients' customer journeys.

Warm regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cv_highlights:
- Front-end and scripting foundation: hand-coded HTML, CSS and JavaScript, a live Android app on Google Play, and Python automation — the technical base for email templates, landing pages and dynamic content
- Structured data and integrations: JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup, llms.txt, and MCP integrations tying WordPress and SEO tools together — hands-on feel for APIs and data flows between systems
- Analytics and segmentation mindset: Google Analytics GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, plus HubSpot Content Marketing certification
- Enterprise-scale delivery: SharePoint digital workplace builds for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (application gallery for 12,000 staff)
- Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor (Belgium, 2018-2019), building front-end features for a healthcare web application in AngularJS and JavaScript
